query:
ALTER TABLE `plants`
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `kingdom` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'Plantae',
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `division` varchar(100),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `class` varchar(100),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `order_name` varchar(100),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `genus` varchar(100),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `species` varchar(100),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `subspecies` varchar(100),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `morphology` json,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `life_cycle` enum('annual', 'biennial', 'perennial', 'variable') DEFAULT 'perennial',
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `growth_conditions` json,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `harvest_period` varchar(100),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `optimal_harvest_stage` varchar(100),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `yield_per_hectare` varchar(100),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `essential_oil_yield` varchar(50),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `storage_duration` varchar(100),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `storage_conditions` text,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `certifications` json;
